name: google-meet
title: Google Meet
description: Start a Google Meet directly from Raycast
author: vitoorgomes

commands.name: default-profile
commands.title: Create Meet
commands.subtitle: Google Meet
commands.description: Creates a new meeting room with your default browser and copy the link to your clipboard.

commands.name: default-profile-and-refocus
commands.title: Create Meet and Refocus
commands.subtitle: Google Meet
commands.description: Creates a new meeting room, copies the link to your clipboard, and refocuses your previous app.

commands.name: manual-profile
commands.title: Create Meet with Specified Profile
commands.subtitle: Google Meet
commands.description: Creates a new meeting room with your default browser and copy the link to your clipboard.

commands.name: manual-profile-and-refocus
commands.title: Create Meet and Refocus with Specified Profile
commands.subtitle: Google Meet
commands.description: Creates a new meeting room using a selected profile, copies the link, and refocuses your previous app.

preferences.title: Open Meetings In
preferences.description: Choose whether meetings open in your browser or in the installed Google Meet PWA. The link is always resolved through a real browser first and copied to your clipboard either way.
preferences.name: launchTarget

preferences.title: Set preferred browser
preferences.description: This allows to override the configuration from the default browser to a specific one when creating the meet. Remember, you have to choose a valid browser
preferences.name: preferredBrowser

preferences.title: Meeting link detection timeout (ms)
preferences.description: How long to keep waiting for Google Meet to generate a link before giving up, in milliseconds. Clamped between 2000 and 30000ms; invalid values fall back to the default.
preferences.name: timeout
